title: Prepending to the input
statement: Let $P$ be a counter program with $R$ natural-number registers and labels in $\Lambda$, let $u,v$ be binary strings, and suppose that on input $v$, every output word $o$ admits a run of at most $b$ steps from label $\ell$, assignment $\rho$, and position $p$ to label-or-halt state $\ell'$, assignment $\rho'$, and position $p'$, appending $e$. Then on input $u$ followed by $v$, every $o$ admits a run of at most $b$ steps with the same labels, assignments, and output extension, starting at position $|u|+p$ and ending at position $|u|+p'$.
